items.headline: Cal RB Ashten Emory scores 2 TDs in comeback win over Virginia Tech, 25-20
items.description: — Reserve running back Ashten Emory ran for two touchdowns and his 2-yard touchdown plunge with 18 seconds left capped Cal's 25-20 comeback win over Virginia Tech on Saturday.
